page.overview:
Who is snatcher?

Snatchers were members of an organisation of unscrupulous bounty hunters formed after Lord Voldemort seized control of the British Ministry of Magic in the summer of 1997.

It appeared to be a relatively informal organisation with the main purpose of rounding up or arresting Muggle-borns and "blood traitors" (when, at the time, simply being one made one an outlaw). At least some of them based themselves in a Snatcher Camp in the Forest of Dean.

The Snatchers organisation was formed by the Ministry of Magic after it was taken over by Lord Voldemort on 1 August 1997, with the purpose of rounding up Muggle-borns, blood traitors and Order of the Phoenix members, i.e. Undesirables on the run. Snatchers were active all over the country and formed Snatcher camps which served as local bases of operation.

When Ron Weasley temporarily abandoned the Horcrux hunt with Harry Potter and Hermione Granger, he was cornered by five Snatchers, who hoped that he was a Muggle-born so they could turn him in to the Ministry for a reward. However, he told them that he was Stan Shunpike. While they were arguing about whether or not he was lying (Ron suggested that they were not all that intelligent, and thought that one of them even had a trace of Troll blood), Ron managed to seize a Blackthorn wand from one of them while also retrieving his own wand before escaping.
